blocks.text:
After breakfast, you set off for the Brazilian side of the falls.

The Guarani called this place “Big Water”. The system comprises 275 cascades on the border between Brazil and Argentina.

Walkways follow the canyon to viewing platforms. One of the main viewpoints is the Devil’s Throat. Water plunges into the gorge, filling the surrounding air with spray.

You can hear the powerful roar of the water before reaching the main platforms. As you approach the cascades, the panorama opens up.

blocks.text: Day 6 · After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Campo Grande, where your local driver takes you to the Pousada Aguapé, in the heart of the Pantanal. Surrounded by rivers, lagoons and lush vegetation, this remarkable wetland is one of Brazil’s most important wildlife destinations and one of the richest ecosystems in the world.
